title: PHLEARN 30 Days of Photoshop: Day 1 Tour — Interface, Workspaces, and Core Techniques
summary: This Day 1 tour from PHLEARN’s 30 Days of Photoshop introduces absolute beginners to Photoshop 2025 by outlining the program’s layout, core tools, and how to navigate and customize workspaces. The host demonstrates creating new documents with template options, loading sample assets, and opening images, then moves into hands-on workspace configuration—pinning and saving custom workspaces, switching between built-in layouts, and arranging panels. A practical photo-editing workflow is shown using selection tools, adjustment layers, and non-destructive techniques, followed by tips on preferences, history states, and help resources. The video emphasizes a non-destructive mindset and a tailored, efficient interface to accelerate learning across the 30-day curriculum, with several AI-enabled and modern features highlighted (Generative Crop, Select Subject) for discoverability and searchability.
topics: Workspace essentials (Essentials, Motion, Painting, Photography, Graphic & Web)
Curating and saving custom workspaces (Photo editing 2025)
Panels and modules (Color, Swatches, Libraries, History, Layers)
Two-finger trackpad panning and spacebar zoom
Tips for undo and history states
Saving in background and auto-save settings

sections.title: Introduction and program goals
sections.description: PHLEARN introduces the 30 Days of Photoshop Day 1 tour, emphasizing orientation to the interface, how tools and modules relate, and the plan to customize workspaces for efficiency.

sections.title: New file creation and templates
sections.description: Demonstrates creating new documents with width, height, and resolution, using built-in templates (including print sizes and flyers), and importing a sample image for practice.

sections.title: Workspace basics and customization
concepts: Built-in workspaces (Essentials, Motion, Painting, Photography, Graphic & Web)
sections.description: Explains the interface’s left toolbar, top options, right-hand modules, and how to switch among built-in workspaces. Shows how to reposition and pin the contextual taskbar, then demonstrates creating and saving a custom workspace (Photo editing 2025) to streamline future sessions.

sections.title: Photo editing workflow and preferences
sections.description: Covers a practical editing workflow: selecting subjects, applying brightness/contrast through adjustment layers, using layer masks with Gaussian blur for edge feathering, exploring AI tools like Generative Crop and Select Subject, and configuring preferences to protect work with autosave and extended history.
